newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent prices surge on NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent prices surge on NYMEX rally.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel and unleaded gasoline prices surged on a rally in the NYMEX products complex on Monday, traders said.
Several Chicago and Group Three traders said players had fled to the sidelines of the spot markets to wait out the futures rally, making it tougher to assess differentials in the Midwest markets.

Shipping officials said disruptions to tanker traffic moving through the Port of New Orleans because of a weekend freighter accident would not have a major impact on products shipments on the Mississippi River to the Midwest.
On the Merc, front-month heating oil was up nearly 3.50 cents a gallon and January unleaded rose more than 2.75 cents a gallon ahead of the close.

Differentials were called largely unchanged in the Group Three and Chicago markets, leaving high sulphur diesel bid 7.50 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 6.75/7.25 cents under in Group Three.
Chicago unleaded gasoline differentials remained bid 5.25 cents a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 4.50 cents under for later deliveries.
Group Three unleaded was steady at 4.75/4.50 cents a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 5.0/4.75 cents under for later deliveries.
